description: Starts an After Hours AI receptionist for the signed-in owner's business, prepaid minutes (min40: 40 minutes for $10; min200: 200 minutes for $50) or resolved conversations (out50: 50 resolved conversations for $24.50; out200: 200 resolved conversations for $98). Real answered phone calls cost $0.25 per minute, billed by the second: each call rounds up to the next whole second, with a 20-second minimum. Robocalls, calls from your own numbers or ours, website and widget chats, text messages, and calls whose transcripts cannot be read are not charged. Pay per resolved conversation: USD 0.49 each, prepaid in packs of 50 (USD 24.50) or 200 (USD 98). A message taken or a booking made counts; everything else is free. At zero the line keeps answering in message-only mode and texts the owner once where owner texts are enabled (otherwise email). No balance goes below zero; buy another outcome pack to restore bookings. Nothing is built or bought until the owner pays: this returns a Stripe checkout link for the first pack, and the line (agent and phone number) is set up automatically once that is paid; its number and forwarding codes are then emailed to the account's address. Every line also gets a SIP address on request, so a phone system can send calls to it with no phone number. Only call it after showing the owner https://odilelabs.com/terms and getting a yes. For prices first use get_answering_line_offer; for a line that already exists use get_answering_line, and top it up with buy_pack (product 'line_minutes' or 'line_outcomes', matching its billing_mode), not a second set-up. United States only (the business line and the owner's mobile must be US numbers). Needs a signed-in connection with the lines:manage permission; limited to 3 set-ups a day per account. Returns { setup_id, status: 'awaiting payment', business_name, business_phone, pack, billing_mode, minutes or outcomes, price_cents, checkout_url, then }.

business_name.description: The business name callers should hear, e.g. "Alvarez Plumbing".

business_phone.description: The business number callers dial today (US, with area code). The owner forwards it to the new line.

city.description: The town the business is in, e.g. "Wellington, FL". The receptionist says it when a caller asks where you are.

description.description: What the business does, in one line; this is what it tells callers.

extra.description: Anything else the receptionist should know.

hours.description: Opening hours by day name, e.g. {"Monday": {"open": "8:00 AM", "close": "5:00 PM"}, "Sunday": "closed"}. A day left out is closed. Omit entirely for Monday to Friday, 9 to 5.

languages.description: Languages besides English the receptionist switches to when a caller does.

owner_confirmed_terms.description: true ONLY after you showed the owner https://odilelabs.com/terms and they said yes. Anything else is refused.

owner_mobile.description: The owner's own mobile (US, with area code): their calls to the line are never charged.

pack.description: The first pack: min40: 40 minutes for $10; min200: 200 minutes for $50; out50: 50 resolved conversations for $24.50; out200: 200 resolved conversations for $98.

services.description: Up to 12 services, e.g. ["drain cleaning", "water heaters"].

name: set_up_answering_line
title: Set up an After Hours answering line (prepaid minutes or resolved conversations)
